The presence of a synergistic interaction between Pergolide and Fallypride suggests a possible enhancement of therapeutic effects, potentially through shared mechanisms that modulate dopaminergic pathways. This is further reinforced by the indication of Piribedil for Parkinsonian Disorder, indicating a direct therapeutic relationship. The integrated evidence implies that Pergolide may contribute to the treatment of Parkinsonian Disorder via mechanisms involving dopaminergic modulation, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
